# Scale of the priced DP residual collectors: preregistered protocol (before data)

Date: 2026-11-01. Follows `research/ic_residual_dp_eq_20261101` (same modes, same pricing). Question: does the distance to matched rho
of `residual-fused-dp` and `residual-fused-eq` hold, grow or shrink with log2 r? Earlier studies reached only log2 r about 36.

## Curves (prime order, prime_explicit; generated by scripts/gen_curve.py BITS 20261701)
p36 (from earlier studies, log2 r = 36.0), p40 (log2 r = 40.2), p42 (log2 r = 42.2). The generator's output is checked by the harness
(group order and generator are verified when the spec loads).

## Claims
- C1 (confirmatory, same rule as the previous study) on p40 and p42: for B in {1, 4} and X in {dp, eq}, the paired 95% interval of
  S(res{B}X)/S(res{B}) lies below 1 at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 (8 cells; all must hold for "met").
- C2 (descriptive): distance to matched rho (S ratio rho -> arm) at w = 0, 0.1, 1 for each arm and curve, and how it moves from p36 to p42.
  No pooling across sessions; each curve is its own session.
- Class: engineering of a generic collision search; no claim to beat rho.

## Design
Arms: rho (rho.negation), baseline res1 and res4 (`residual`), candidates res{1,4}dp and res{1,4}eq, res1aa (A/A copy of res1).
12 targets per curve, target seed 20261801, measure seed 20261802, 2 rounds + 1 warm-up, alternate_measured; local L0 (counts deterministic; no
wall-clock claim; isolab-eks route unavailable); L2 specs kept. Per-step pricing as in the previous study (DP test, orientation read, negations each 1 op).
Positive control: harness verification of every answer and `ecbench verify --replay 12`. A/A interval must contain 1; all records verified; audits OK, else void.

## Decision rule (frozen)
C1 met iff all 8 cells hold; otherwise report which fail. Nothing is tuned after data. The DP bits rule b = floor(log2 r / 2) - 9 is unchanged (b = 9 or 10 at these sizes).
